title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning: Performance, Consistency, and Faithfulness Across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in model performance, reasoning consistency, and faithfulness across 15 typologically diverse languages using crosslingual thinking trace substitution (interchanging reasoning traces between languages) and trace perturbations (truncation and error injection) to compare behaviors in high-resource versus low-resource languages.
